item.description:
• Fixed "Move to Homebrew" wrongly disabling apps that are not actually behind: apps whose Homebrew version carries a build suffix (e.g. Claude, Edge) or whose installed version has a browser-engine prefix (e.g. Brave) can be moved again. The picker now also says why an app is disabled (installed version vs. Homebrew version)
  • The Homebrew catalog now downloads in under a second instead of minutes, so your manually-installed apps appear without a long wait after the catalog refreshes
  • When a newer Kegwatch is available, the menu bar icon now shows an exclamation mark and the "Check for Updates" menu item says which version is ready
  • Importing a Brewfile now warns when it contains lines that are not packages (a Brewfile can run commands), and exporting or installing a Brewfile now tells you when it fails instead of staying silent
